scene_description: A fenced courtyard with stone brick flooring containing multiple small structures. A spruce planks shelter in one corner houses the potted dead bush on a raised floor. A cobblestone hut, barrel, hay block, lantern, and oak logs serve as distractors. The player must explore the enclosed area and enter the spruce shelter to find the potted dead bush.
task_text: Find the potted dead bush hidden somewhere in this enclosed courtyard. Explore the structures and look inside them.
design_notes: The potted dead bush is at relative position ~8,1,~8 inside a 4x4 spruce planks shelter with a 2-block wide doorway facing west (at x=6). The fenced perimeter (20x20 blocks) keeps the player contained. Distractor structures include a cobblestone hut at ~-5,-5 to ~-3,-3, scattered decorative blocks (barrel, lantern, hay, logs). The player spawns at center and must navigate ~11 blocks diagonally to reach the shelter and enter it.
